connector.name: GetCurrentOffer
connector.registryDescription: Search live credit card merchant offers across Amex, Chase, Citi, PayPal, Rakuten, Capital One.
connector.summary: Hosted at getcurrentoffer.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.getcurrentoffer, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key for the GetCurrentOffer MCP server. Generate one for free at https://getcurrentoffer.com/api-keys. Alternatively, hosted clients (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT connectors, Claude.ai) can omit this header and use the OAuth 2.1 + Dynamic Client Registration flow advertised in the WWW-Authenticate response.
